title: Fix Mob Ai Tweaks Tags!
description: A simple datapack that acts to fix Mob Ai Tweak's treasure tags as Issue #229
body:
Fixes [Issue #229](https://github.com/skycatminepokie/Mob-AI-Tweaks/commit/1764a128b5a6bcdfa2d46f11b7a8cb0d880819d3) on the github's issue tracker for version 1.21.11. Mostly used for compatibility with [Enchancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchancement).

To be fully clear this wasn't made by me but I have permission to use this, the person who made the mod is [skycatminepokie's message](https://discord.com/channels/507304429255393322/789953494534324264/1493300258510340146).
